response.justification: Bogdan brings 15+ years of hands-on engineering with unusually relevant developer-tooling depth — he authored a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), built and maintained GitLab/CI/deploy infrastructure, and has taught test automation and TDD courses. He clearly meets and exceeds the 8-year development and 3-year developer-tools minimums, and has incidental mobile exposure (iOS/Apple TV apps, mobile device orchestration). However, the role is fundamentally a people-management position, and the resume shows no evidence of the required 2 years of people management or formal team leadership: no direct reports, no performance/1:1 responsibilities, no roadmap ownership, and no organizational-change leadership. Titles are IC-track (Senior/Staff Software Engineer), and the founder role at GISCollective appears to be a solo/open-source effort rather than team leadership. He would be a strong candidate for a Staff/Principal IC role on the same team; as a manager hire he is a stretch and would need a screening call to probe for unlisted mentoring or lead experience.
strengths: Deep, demonstrable developer-tools work: test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD and build infrastructure
15+ years of broad engineering across web, mobile, desktop, embedded and high-throughput services
Strong knowledge-sharing track record — workshops, conference talks, and a multi-module Selenium/TDD course
concerns: No stated people-management experience; misses the 2-year minimum outright
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Mobile-platform exposure is dated and incidental, not ecosystem-scale platform work

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and testing infrastructure depth
No formal technical leadership or roadmap ownership evidence
